result: Let S be the full 11-generator range of the 2024 Krebs–Gachechiladze 5x5 grid, and let rho be ANY positive operator with range exactly S. For EVERY complex rank-four local map K:C^5->C^4 on Alice, the range of (K tensor I)rho(K tensor I)^* is spanned by vectors of Schmidt rank <=2. The same holds for rank-four Bob maps by S's tensor-swap invariance, and after ANY further local map on the opposite side. Therefore the generalized range criterion cannot prove SN>=3 for any 4x4 projection of this source range with at least one rank-four map. This is NOT a proof that the projected state has SN<=2; a high-SN state with SR2-spanned range is not excluded.
source_range: From https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 Figure 2 and Appendix B, let A=|02>+|11>+|20>, U=|00>, V=|01>, W=|10>, B=|12>+|34>, P=|14>, C=|21>+|43>, Q=|22>+|33>, J=|23>, F=|32>, G=|41>, and S=span(A,U,V,W,B,P,C,Q,J,F,G). All generators except A have SR<=2. The original trace18 PPT/SN3 grid and every positive diagonal weighting have range exactly S. S is invariant under tensor-factor swap: V<->W, B<->C, P<->G, J<->F, while A,U,Q are fixed.
range_transfer: For positive rho and any linear local L, ran(L rho L^*)=L ran(rho). Hence it is enough to span K(S) by rank2 vectors. If q=K(A+sum c_j g_j) is rank<=2, with coefficient of A nonzero and g_j the other source generators, then q together with the rank<=2 K(g_j) spans K(S). Any further map on Bob preserves both the spanning relation and SR<=2.
chart_four_nonzero_lambda: If the kernel of K has nonzero |4> coefficient, after an invertible output basis take K|0,1,2,3>=|0,1,2,3>, K|4>=v0|0>+v1|1>+v2|2>+lambda|3>. For lambda!=0 take the SOURCE vector q=lambda*A+lambda*U-V-C+lambda*Q-(v0-v2)*J. Its projected 4x5 coefficient rows are [lambda,-1,lambda,-v0,0], [0,lambda,0,-v1,0], [lambda,-1,lambda,-v0,0], [0,0,0,0,0]. Thus rank(Kq)<=2, and its coefficient lambda of A is nonzero.
chart_four_zero_lambda: In the same chart when lambda=0, take q=A+W+C+(v1-v2)*J. Its projected rows are [0,0,1,v0,0], [1,1,0,v1,0], [1,1,0,v1,0], [0,0,0,0,0]. It has rank<=2 and A coefficient1 for every complex v0,v1,v2.
chart_three: If K's kernel has nonzero |3> coefficient, an alternative chart fixes K|0,1,2,4>=|0,1,2,3> and sends K|3>=v0|0>+v1|1>+v2|2>+lambda|3>. For EVERY complex lambda take q=A+U-lambda*V-lambda*C+Q+(v0-v2)*J. Its projected rows are [1,-lambda,1,v0,0], [0,1,0,v1,0], [1,-lambda,1,v0,0], [0,0,0,0,0]. Its rank is <=2 and the A coefficient is1. If neither tail coefficient is nonzero, K's kernel lies in span{|0>,|1>,|2>}, so K(A) itself has rank<=2; all other generators already do. These cases cover every rank-four map and arbitrary complex phases.

exact_symbolic_check.observed: Integer multivariate polynomial arithmetic independently constructs the original five-by-five source kets, both four-parameter linear-map charts, and all three explicit q vectors. It verifies all 40 3x3 minors identically for each case (120 polynomial identities total), the row equalities, and the stated A coefficients. This is an exact symbolic identity check, not a finite selected-kernel sample. The range/positive-operator and local-map implications are written linear algebra.

consequence_and_limits: The earlier full-span result for the separate 2025 4x5 grid range is in frontier-20261028-grid-projection-full-span-v1.json SHA256 3cebc491cbdb653506dbb138c3b3b417988ae17396ef14bc636b187e84526213. Thus a pure range-spanning obstruction cannot certify 4x4 SN>=3 from rank-four compression of EITHER these two explicit grid source ranges. This says nothing about other source ranges, direct 4x4 constructions, non-range witnesses, or whether a projected state is actually SN2. Independent/formal review and novelty remain open.
